title: Prefix parser before halting
statement: Let $\alpha$ and $x$ be finite bit strings. Starting on the encoding that doubles each bit of $\alpha$, then appends $01$ and $x$, the prefix parser after $2|\alpha|+1$ steps is in the live state recording the bit $0$, its input head is at position $2|\alpha|+2$, and its output is exactly $\alpha$.
replaced:
For all bit strings $\alpha$ and $x$, after exactly $2\abs{\alpha}+1$
transitions on the self-delimiting pairing $\langle \alpha, x\rangle$, the
doubled-bit prefix parser is in the live state recording the separator's
first bit $0$, its input head is at position $2\abs{\alpha}+2$, and it has
emitted exactly $\alpha$.
